And thanks to HBO Max’s new Black Friday deal, new and returning subscribers can now watch both shows for less. The streaming service is currently offering a 50 percent discount for Black Friday , bringing the price of its Basic With Ads plan down to $5.49 per month (about $6 off) for one year. The promotion runs through November 30th, and you can subscribe either via HBO Max or Amazon . HBO Max Where to Buy: $10.49 $5.49 at Amazon (monthly, with ads) $10.99 $5.49 at HBO Max (monthly, with ads) HBO Max has plenty of great movies and shows to keep you entertained well into the new year, no matter which plan you choose. You’ll find a wide selection of TV shows, including Heated Rivalry , Dune: Prophecy , The White Lotus , Euphoria , and Knight of the Seven Kingdoms , alongside longtime favorites like Game of Thrones and The Big Bang Theory . There’s more on the way, too, including HBO’s highly anticipated Harry Potter series, which premieres on Christmas . There’s plenty to watch beyond TV, too. HBO Max’s extensive movie catalog currently includes films like Sinners , One Battle After Another , Marty Supreme , Backrooms , and Wuthering Heights . And if you’re a sports fan, both the Standard and Premium plans also include access to select live events from MLB, U.S. Soccer, the NCAA, and more. What you get ultimately depends on the subscription tier you choose. HBO Max’s Basic with Ads plan lets you stream on two devices at once but doesn’t include live sports. The ad-free Standard plan ($18.49 a month), meanwhile, adds live sports and up to 30 offline downloads. The Premium plan ($22.99 a month) adds a few more perks, including 4K streaming and Dolby Atmos with select titles, up to 100 downloads, and the ability to stream movies and shows on four devices simultaneously.
